name: Mille Crêpe Cake
description: Hundreds of paper-thin crepes layered with lightly sweetened whipped cream into a spectacular tower of texture.
ingredients: a handful of fresh shiso leaves, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with neutral vegetable oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soba noodles and shichimi togarashi until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the bonito flakes with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 30 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
